rules.name: Zero-Trust Security & Key Protection
rules.description: Never expose Gemini or Google Maps API keys to the client; isolate Firestore tenant paths and verify auth tokens.
directives: Never emit client-side Gemini or Google Maps API keys.
All Firestore operations must use /users/{uid}/journals/{id} paths.
Every API route must execute adminAuth.verifyIdToken(token) before downstream execution.

rules.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines Design System
rules.description: Ensure clean visual hierarchy, legible typography, fluid motion, and dark mode compliance.
directives: Follow Apple HIG principles: Clarity, Deference, and Depth.
Use rounded continuous corner radii, subtle blur materials, and accessible contrast ratios.
Incorporate spring physics animations for interaction states.

rules.name: Maps API Proxy Directives
rules.description: Ensure all Google Maps API queries are proxied via backend routes with input validation and rate limiting.
directives: Proxy all Maps API calls through backend route handlers.
Authenticate caller tokens and sanitize all coordinate/query inputs.

rules.name: Pre-Commit Secret Scanning & TDD Enforcement
rules.description: Block hardcoded secrets and enforce passing tests prior to git commits.
directives: Block hardcoded API keys and credentials in staged commits.
Execute automated test suites (security.test.ts and sanitizer.test.ts) before git commits.

rules.name: Agentic Threat Modeling & Secure Coding
rules.description: Mandate structured 5-zone threat analysis, OWASP LLM guardrails, and input sanitization before generating implementations.
directives: Before generating code or system architecture, output a Threat Summary Table covering: Input Surfaces, Planning & Reasoning, Tool Execution, Memory & State, and Inter-System Communication.
Sanitize all inputs via strict schema validation to prevent injection.
Encode all dynamic LLM outputs prior to rendering in HTML/JS.
Never use unparameterized strings or insecure defaults.

rules.name: Gemini Model Resilience & Fallback Ladder
rules.description: Enforce resilient fallback chains across Gemini model generations.
directives: Never hardcode a single model string for generation.
Wrap all content generation with an automated fallback ladder: gemini-3.6-flash -> gemini-3.1-flash-lite -> gemini-flash-latest -> gemini-3.7-flash.
Catch recoverable codes (503, 429, 404, 500) and step sequentially down the fallback chain before failing.

rules.name: Zero-Crash Payload Hygiene & Transaction Verification
rules.description: Guarantee payload hygiene before database persistence and require explicit error recovery.
directives: Strip all undefined fields from objects before passing them to Firestore setDoc/updateDoc.
Perform defensive null-safe destructuring on all request bodies, params, and headers.
Never fail persistence silently; if a write fails, maintain the user's input buffer and display a high-contrast retry alert.
Ensure both user input and AI output are successfully committed to state.

rules.name: Functional Stability & User Walkthroughs
rules.description: Require explicit step-by-step user walkthrough test cases for all interactive elements.
directives: Every interactive UI trigger (buttons, forms, toggles, debrief flows) must include concrete user walkthrough test steps.
Document expected visual states, pending states, error escalations, and deterministic transition outcomes.
